description: A deductively closed propositional theory is complete and consistent exactly when its associated Boolean filter is an ultrafilter.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.complete_iff_ultrafilter.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsComplete T ↔
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsUltrafilter
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filterOfTheory T hT)
